expanded_phrases.million-dollar: The Studio readback must be credible in a founder/vendor meeting: scannable sections, explicit status, no debug-first payloads, and clear no-send safety.
expanded_phrases.make it work: The mock workflow must visibly complete source, prompt, job, and handoff review states with readable readbacks.
expanded_phrases.working: Every readback either shows status and next action or a specific empty/blocker state.
expanded_phrases.live: App-visible terminal done still requires deploy and authenticated live smoke after local implementation.
expanded_phrases.clean: Prompt, job, and handoff payloads render as concise review cards; raw code/JSON is only available inside diagnostics.
expanded_phrases.pipeline: This packet improves the readback stage of the first-party Studio pipeline only; later packets handle reusable libraries and output generation.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Studio remains a first-party BNA Operations workflow; external vendors are adapters only after a setup packet.

requirements.statement: Replace raw code/test-looking Studio readbacks with structured prompt, job, correction, and handoff review surfaces while preserving expandable diagnostics.
requirements.expected_result: Operators see readable Studio review cards first and can open diagnostics only when they need the raw payload.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt review shows hash, layer count, source-boundary and no-send safety flags, and a short excerpt.
Layer review cards show layer type, status, hash, safety flags, and readable excerpts.
Correction preview shows patch id, scope, confirmation state, affected operations, and diagnostics.
Job review shows job type, status, provider/model, scene/asset counts, no-external-write readback, and diagnostics.
Handoff review shows idempotency key, content job id, no-publish/no-send readback, external write readback, and diagnostics.
Raw payloads remain available only behind diagnostics controls.

criteria: Current-state audit identifies the raw readback defect.
